alias: Den tall lamp on with sideboard lamp
description: Turns the den tall lamp (WiZ) on when the sideboard lamp's plug goes from under 1 W to 1 W or more (owner, 2026-10-23). The plug measures whole watts, and the sideboard lamp at its lowest setting draws under 1 W and reads 0, so that setting cannot be seen; at its highest it draws 9 W. Fires only on that change between two real readings: a reading coming back from unavailable never counts, and there is deliberately no re-check on HA start or reload, so the tall lamp can still be used on its own. A rise within 10 seconds of the plug being switched on is ignored (owner, 2026-11-06): the plug reports 5 W the instant it is switched on although the sideboard lamp, which comes back off after a power cut, is not lit, so restarting the plug with den_multibutton_sideboard_lamp_restart turned the tall lamp back on. Pair: den_tall_lamp_off_with_sideboard_lamp. Source: tools/ha/automations in the HomeAssistant repo.

conditions.value_template: {{ 0 <= trigger.from_state.state | float(-1) < 1 and trigger.to_state.state | float(-1) >= 1 and (trigger.to_state.last_changed - states.switch.den_plug_sideboard_lamp_switch.last_changed).total_seconds() > 10 }}
